releases.title: Version 1.1.0: compare revisions
items: PDF Overlay: lay the new revision of a drawing over the old one, old in red, new in green and the same in black, with every difference listed and aligned for you.
Text Comparison: see every changed word, number, clause and table row of two revisions side by side.

Check which sheets are compared before you start: each one shows both pages, with a page picker, a large preview of each pair, and a mark on sheets that need a look. New comparison opens another comparison with the same files.
Review across revisions: close out the old revision's comments against the new one, and copy comments to the matching place.

Close-out list: comments with text come first, highlights can be hidden, a click zooms to the comment, and Close Out As… says what each outcome means. Window titles show unsaved changes, and a text comparison shows the page in view, with Go to page.
Save a comparison as one PDF that anyone can open, export the overlay, or export a change register to Excel.

More room in a comparison: fold or resize any pane, fold the left pane's sections to one line, and Maximise to hide everything but the windows (Esc brings it back). Header buttons are labelled, and the overlay shows a colour key.

Lining up sheets is easier: a Line up button on the overlay, a banner on any sheet that may not be lined up, plain words for each sheet's alignment (mark one It looks right), and step-by-step guidance to click the same point on both drawings. First-time tips show the way on your first comparison.
All of it on this device and offline. Help has a new chapter, Compare revisions.

releases.title: Version 1.0.0, the first public release
items: Open PDFs of any size in tabs, read, search and print them, all in your browser.
Comment and mark up: highlights, sticky notes, text boxes, callouts, shapes, stamps and signatures, saved as standard PDF comments that other PDF viewers show.
Measure drawings to scale: distance, perimeter and area, with snapping to the lines of the drawing.
Organize pages, fill and create forms, protect files with a password, redact for good, and recognise the text in scans (OCR).
Free, with no account: your documents stay on this device, and the app works offline once it has loaded.
